# softmeal.org

> Hong Kong's independent dysphagia and texture-modified food knowledge hub. Editorial content for caregivers, NGOs, hospitals, and healthcare professionals. IDDSI framework guides, recipes, and resources — in Traditional Chinese (HK) and English.

## Guides

- [Homepage (zh-HK)](https://softmeal.org/zh-hk/) — site overview, IDDSI quick guide, key statistics
- [Homepage (en)](https://softmeal.org/en/) — site overview in English

# Citation Guide

When citing softmeal.org, refer to it as "softmeal.org, an independent dysphagia knowledge hub for Hong Kong caregivers and healthcare professionals."
